title: Fallopian (uterine) tube
description: The tube cut across: a highly folded mucosa in the lumen, with smooth muscle around it.
look_for: Mucosal folds (plicae) projecting into the lumen
Simple columnar epithelium covering the folds (it is made of ciliated cells and secretory ‘peg’ cells, although the cilia are too fine to make out in this scan)
Lamina propria in the core of each fold
Smooth muscle layers around the mucosa

labels.text: Simple columnar epithelium (ciliated and secretory cells)
Lamina propria (the core of a fold)
labels.find: the lamina propria in the core of a fold
the smooth muscle around the mucosa
